approval: Approved by the project owner on 2026-11-11 (direct instruction). Expires on the expiresOn date; re-review before renewal.

advisories.fix: decode-uri-component 0.5.1, outside query-string 7's range; no minio release moves off query-string 7
advisories.reachability: Not reached: minio only calls query-string's stringify (helpers.mjs, internal/client.mjs), which never decodes. The vulnerable decoder runs only in query-string's parse paths.

advisories.fix: stream-json 3.6.0+, a major bump minio 8 does not accept
advisories.reachability: Not reached: minio uses stream-json only in listenBucketNotification (notification.mjs). The API calls getObject, putObject, removeObject, presignedGetObject, newPostPolicy and presignedPostPolicy, never notifications.

scope: API production dependencies whose vulnerable code paths the API does not call
reviewRequirement: Re-check reachability when the API starts using another minio method, and remove an entry as soon as minio ships a compatible fix. Any new advisory ID, critical finding or install path fails CI.
